lessons.title: Principles of Sensation: Transduction, Receptive Fields, & Sensory Coding
lessons.description: Understand sensory transduction, receptive fields, center-surround antagonism, lateral inhibition, and Weber's law.

lessons.title: The Visual Pathway: From Retina to Striate Cortex & Dual Processing Streams
lessons.description: Examine photoreceptors, the retinogeniculate pathway, Hubel & Wiesel's cortical columns, and the dorsal ('where/how') vs. ventral ('what') streams.

lessons.title: Hearing, Touch, & Pain: Auditory Transduction, Somatosensory Homunculus, & Gate Control
lessons.description: Explore cochlear hair cells, tonotopic maps, Penfield's sensory homunculus, nociceptive fibers, and the Gate Control Theory of pain.

lessons.title: The Motor Hierarchy: Planning, Executing, & Calibrating Movement
lessons.description: Trace motor commands from prefrontal intention to premotor sequencing, primary motor execution, corticospinal decussation, and upper vs. lower motor lesions.
